correctness.rationale: The Fano incidence graph is constructed in two independent models (nonzero GF(2)^3 triples and cyclic Singer translates). All 2^14 deletion masks are checked for foresthood using union-find, with a separate DFS implementation. No feasible sets of fewer than four vertices exist. There are exactly 70 four-set optima, 812 feasible five-sets and 2254 feasible six-sets. At cap five, exact enumeration gives 882 states, 700 edges, fourteen components of 51 and 168 isolated vertices; geometric kernel counting independently accounts for the fourteen nontrivial components. At cap six, the constructed 3136-state, 8008-edge graph is connected. BFS from all states confirms eccentricity j+6 for each feasible j-set, radius 10, diameter 12, and 382466 +2 and 840 +4 Hamming-excess unordered pairs. Every one of the 2415 distinct optimum pairs reaches the target in exactly its symmetric-difference length, also verified by a separate monotone-only search. Both standalone included programs actually executed successfully. Since the theorem concerns exactly this finite graph, exhaustive finite loops are a complete proof of the enumerated claims; no infinite case is inferred.

originality.rationale: The established Heawood minimum feedback-set size, 70 count, and geometric kernel description are expressly prior work, and the published 2023 theorem on subcubic non-minimum fixed-size exchange is acknowledged. Neither inspected claim yields the sharp cap-five isolation census, Hamming geodesics for all seventy optima under cap-six TAR, the exact full cap-six eccentricities, or the Hamming-excess histogram. Some cap-five structural consequences of the known kernel description are clearly separated from the genuine added metric. No stronger covering claim was found in the actual published-record and primary-literature searches; residual risk remains for inaccessible full text and unindexed equivalent work.
residual_risks: The 2023 general FVS article full text was unavailable in this run: HAL OA access was denied and the optional authorized institutional route reported VPN disconnected. Its visible theorem statements were read, but appendix-level priority is not ruled out.
An unindexed historical claim phrased in terms of induced-forest deletion or Fano incidence matroid parity might imply some or all of the metric.
The 14 nontrivial cap-five components are a routine corollary of the known 70-set kernel classification, and are not independently claimed as novel.

value.rationale: This is a motivated exact threshold and shortest-path classification on the unique cubic 6-cage, the smallest incidence-geometry benchmark where minimum feedback sets are disconnected under exchange. It precisely quantifies the buffer required for globally feasible reconfiguration, shows all optimal pairs then attain their intrinsic symmetric-difference lower bound despite the failure of the same property on nonoptima, and supplies exact component and eccentricity metrics. The combination is a nontrivial, reusable benchmark for resource-constrained cycle-breaking algorithms, rather than a recomputation of the known 70-set census.
